bosses.name: Rhahk'Zor
bosses.general: Ogre foreman behind the first door: hits hard, nothing else.
bosses.tank: Use your cooldowns if you're low level, he slams hard.
bosses.healer: Keep the tank topped, his hits are big.

bosses.name: Miner Johnson
bosses.general: Rare miner: Rend on the tank, easy.

bosses.name: Sneed's Shredder
bosses.general: Sneed in his shredder: Terrify fears, Distracting Pain. When the shredder breaks, Sneed jumps out: kill him too.
bosses.tank: Hold the shredder, then grab Sneed when he pops out.
bosses.dps: Shredder first, then Sneed right away.

bosses.name: Sneed
bosses.general: Jumps out of his broken shredder: Disarm, otherwise easy.
bosses.tank: Pick him up as soon as he lands.

bosses.name: Gilnid
bosses.general: The smelter goblin: Molten Metal splashes fire, he comes with goblin crafters.
bosses.tank: Pull the crafters with him and keep them on you.

bosses.name: Mr. Smite
bosses.general: At two thirds and one third health he stuns everyone near (Smite Stomp), runs to his chest and switches weapons: two axes, then a big hammer.
bosses.tank: Tank him near the chest so the weapon swap is quick; expect harder hits after each swap.
bosses.healer: Top everyone before each stomp; the hammer phase hits the tank hard.
bosses.dps: Ranged stay out of the stomp; burn him in the hammer phase.

bosses.name: Captain Greenskin
bosses.general: On the ship with his pirates: Cleave and Poisoned Harpoon.
bosses.tank: Face him away from the group for the Cleave; pick up the pirates.
bosses.dps: Pirates first if they're loose, then the captain; stay behind him.

bosses.name: Edwin VanCleef
bosses.general: Defias leader: Thrash gives him extra hits, and at half health he calls two Defias Blackguards.
bosses.tank: Hold him and grab both Blackguards when they come.
bosses.healer: Thrash spikes the tank; heal ahead of it.
bosses.dps: Kill the Blackguards when they come, then VanCleef.

bosses.name: Cookie
bosses.general: The murloc cook in the ship: eats to heal himself, otherwise easy.
bosses.dps: Burn him so his healing doesn't matter.
